title: A Tryouts for the Recipe
author: Juniper Ravensworth
blurb: Dominic Coldharbour, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
